name: Virtual Fighting Championship 2
detailed_description:
Step into the fight—literally.
Sequel to the VR OG fighting game VFC, VFC2 is a full-body virtual reality fighting game where you are the controller. Punch, dodge, and gesture your way through intense PvE and PvP battles, performing real movements to unleash shockwaves, fireballs, and devastating ultimate attacks—just like in Street Fighter™ or Dragon Ball™.

Game Modes:

  • Single Player Campaign: Take on a variety of enemies and challenges as you fight your way through a story-driven journey.

  • PvP Battles: Face off against real players online in intense 1v1 matchups.

  • Sandbox Training: Enter a freeform training arena to master your moves and experiment with combos at your own pace.

Choose Your Fighter:
Pick from 6 unique characters, each with their own set of abilities, strengths, and fighting styles. Whether you prefer fast, up-close melee combat, mid-range ambush tactics using smart ability combos, or long-range pressure and control—there’s a fighter for you.

Key Features:

  • Full-body VR combat—your fists, your movement, your fight

  • Dynamic special attacks triggered by real-life gestures

  • Diverse roster of characters with distinct fighting styles

  • Competitive online PvP and rich solo campaign

  • Immersive training mode to practice and discover new combos

VFC2 brings the energy, spectacle, and strategy of classic fighting games into VR—where your skill is truly tested by your movement.
